_note: Hand-kept gate world for I7/S1 (packs/inventory-purchasing.md §10 row I7 S1). Synthetic; every supplier is simulated. The worldgen answer keys hold no negotiation plant (RG-S1 is stock_below_reorder with no detector, and the gate worlds have 2 simulated suppliers, not the 3 personalities, and no purchases budget or business policy), so this fixture carries HAND VALUES. The shortfall is RG-S1's: takeaway boxes at South, 30 pc on hand against a minimum of 50 = 20 pc short, last price 800 paise (tools/worldgen/answer-key/restaurant_group.json RG-S1). Deal-review inputs are hand values for that outlet.
_margin_rule_applies: R47 D3 (deal_inputs v3, 0026): this hand world margins each quote over dishes that use the boxes, so the margin rule applies; tests/negotiate/test_negotiate_rules.py covers items it does not apply to.

expected._worked: Personalities (pack §6), reference 800: steady 10200 bp = 816, discounter 9000 bp = 720 (minimum order 3 x 20 = 60 pc in its terms), premium 11200 bp = 896. Policy: target 9500 bp = 760, walk-away 11000 bp = 880, 2 counters. Decision 1: steady counter at best rival 720; discounter has no rival below it and the target 760 is above 720, so no counter -> accept; premium 896 > 880 cannot be accepted -> counter at 720. Replies: steady 10050 bp = 804, premium 11000 bp = 880. Decision 2: counter both at 720. Replies: steady floor 9900 bp = 792, premium 10800 bp = 864. Decision 3: counters spent, both <= 880 -> accept. Review: discounter 60 pc > 30 pc usable before expiry -> moq_exceeds_need; steady 792 x 20 = 15840 <= 500000, margin 6400 >= 6000, open 0 < need 20000, 15 >= 7 days -> pass; premium 864 passes too. Best passing = lowest price = steady at 792.

budget_stop._worked: Run budget = the 3 round-1 extractions: at decision 1 no counter is affordable and the chooser makes no call. Defaults on the round-1 quotes: steady 816 <= 880 accept, discounter 720 accept, premium 896 > 880 walk. Review: discounter refused (moq_exceeds_need), steady passes -> PO steady at 816.

invented_price._worked: The steady round-1 extraction is planted as 700 (INR 7.00), a price its reply (INR 8.16) does not contain: steady is dropped, not_in_reply:unit_price_minor. Default policy on the rest: discounter 720 has no rival below it and the target 760 is above it -> accept; premium 896 -> counter 720 -> 880 -> counter 720 -> 864 -> accept (<= 880). Review: discounter refused (moq_exceeds_need), premium 864 passes -> PO premium at 864.

f1_plants._worked: R-C F1's plants on the discounter's round-1 reading of 'we can supply 20 pc ... at INR 7.20 per pc. Payment: net 7 days. <clause with 60 pc>'. swap (qty 60 pc, minimum 0): 60 pc is a token before the unit, so it grounds, but 60 pc is not the RFQ's 20 pc -> qty_not_rfq. omit (minimum 0): '60' before 'pc' is claimed by no field and is not the RFQ quantity -> unbound_number. days (price 700, minimum 0): 7.00 is the token '7' before 'days', not after 'INR' and before 'per pc' -> not_in_reply:unit_price_minor. In all three the discounter drops out at round 1; default policy on the rest, reference 800 (target 760, walk-away 880): decision 1 steady 816 has no rival below it -> counter at the target 760, premium 896 -> counter at steady's 816; replies steady max(10050 bp = 804, 760) = 804, premium max(11000 bp = 880, 816) = 880. Decision 2: steady counter 760 -> max(9900 bp = 792, 760) = 792; premium counter 804 -> max(10800 bp = 864, 804) = 864. Decision 3: counters spent, 792 and 864 <= 880 -> accept both. Review: both pass (margins 6400 / 6300 >= 6000, need 20000 > open 0, days 15 / 30 >= 7, no minimum). Best = steady at 792 x 20.

injection._worked: The steady supplier's terms carry the injected note, whose 'create_v1' holds a digit no field claims -> steady dropped, unbound_number. Recorded chooser (record.py: the rule default, except accept at decision 2 a supplier already at the walk-away): decision 1 discounter 720 has no rival below it and the target 760 is above it -> accept; premium 896 > 880 -> counter at the discounter's 720 -> reply max(11000 bp = 880, 720) = 880. Decision 2: premium at 880 = walk-away -> accept. Review: discounter refused (moq_exceeds_need), premium 880 x 20 = 17600 <= budget, margin 6300 >= 6000, need 20000 > open 0, 30 >= 7 days -> pass. PO premium at 880.
